# Draft:Swarnava Chakraborty

----
Swarnava Chakraborty is an Indian film editor and director primarily active in Bengali cinema. He is a graduate of Roopkala Kendro, a Government of West Bengal film and social communication institute. He is best known for his work on the ZEE5 series Ronkini Bhavan (2025) and the feature film Ananta (2022).
Early life and education
Swarnava Chakraborty graduated with a degree in Film Studies before pursuing a Post Graduate degree in Media Studies (Film and Television) from the University of Calcutta. He subsequently completed a specialized Post Graduate program in Film Editing from Roopkala Kendro, an institute under the Information and Cultural Affairs Department of the Government of West Bengal.
Career
Swarnava began his career in independent cinema as the editor for the English-language feature film Talking of Michelangelo (2017), directed by Modhurima Sinha. The film, which explores the complex relationship between a mentor and a protégé, was showcased at the Kolkata International Film Festival and received critical attention in national media for its narrative structure.
Following his debut, Swarnava Chakraborty worked across a variety of formats including feature films, documentaries, and digital series. In 2022, he edited the feature film Ananta, directed by Abhinandan Dutta, which was noted for its intricate narrative style. He further established his presence in Bengali feature cinema as the editor for Mayaa (2023) and Sada Ronger Prithibi (2024), directed by Raajhorshee De. In 2024, His work in the digital space includes editing for regional OTT platforms such as Platform8 and Addatimes. In 2021, he edited the web film Sorshephool for Platform8.
Swarnava Chakraborty has also contributed to socially relevant documentary filmmaking. In 2024, he edited Beyond the Blues, a documentary directed by Debalina exploring the lives of transmen in India. The film was featured at the 10th Kolkata People's Film Festival and received coverage in The Times of India for its empathetic portrayal of queer narratives.
In 2025, Swarnava Chakraborty served as the lead editor for the ZEE5 original psychological thriller series Ronkini Bhavan. for which he received a nomination for Best Editing (OTT) at the Zee 24 Ghanta Binodone Sera 24 awards recognizing his contribution to the high-stakes visual storytelling of the show.
His portfolio includes projects for several regional Over-the-top (OTT) platforms, including Addatimes and Platform8. In addition to his editing work, he has ventured into directing some corporate films and Ads project .
